prompt: We self-assessed and have 14 unimplemented 800-171 practices. How does our SPRS score work?
assertions: Starts at 110 and deducts per unimplemented practice using DoD Assessment Methodology weights (5/3/1)
States the score floor/range: down to -203
Requires a completed SSP as the basis, with the Basic Assessment (score, scope, date) posted to SPRS
Mentions special-case scoring nuances accurately (e.g., MFA 3.5.3 and FIPS-validated crypto 3.13.11 partial-credit rules, or an accurate general statement of the 1/3/5 weighting logic)
Covers the annual affirmation duty and accuracy risk (False Claims Act)
